_note: Station names from the UIC Primary Location Code register, held in the Central Reference File Database that RailNetEurope hosts for UIC. This fills the countries where the trainline-eu catalogue in uic-stations.json is thin, and is only consulted for codes that table does not have. No reuse licence has been identified for the register, which makes this the least settled table in this repo: it holds names and codes and nothing else, and it is one file and one loader to remove if the terms turn out to forbid it. Rebuilt by scripts/build-uic-from-plc.py from a CRD export; do not edit by hand, put corrections in the OVERRIDES map in src/lib/tickets/stations.ts.
